facts: In Iran, it is against the law to own a dog as a pet. However, if an owner can prove the dog is a guard or hunting dog, this restriction doesn’t apply. Muslim reticence concerning dogs is perhaps due to the fact that rabies has always been endemic in the Middle East.
Pugs and other dogs with short muzzles have a peculiar head-type known as "Brachycephalic."
Dogs are omnivores -- they eat meat, grains and vegetables.
Dogs know from which nostril a smell has entered.
The shortest living dog was a Chihuahua named Milly, who measured only 3.8 inches tall.
